items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: I remember there was a place called, like I said, from Donnellsville, where they called Froggy Moore from Donnellsville.

ctx.x: Somebody mentioned that Froggy Moore once, that he was up there. What was that little suburb, little town, village? Froggy Moore.
I remember there was a place called, like I said, from Donnellsville, where they called Froggy Moore from Donnellsville.
Well, Richard M. Jones was from around that neighborhood too, I think. Yeah. Did you ever know him? He was a piano player?
